problem.lead: Sun care for moving bodies has been one of two things.
problem.body:
Beautiful, but undone by sweat.
Or functional, but no pleasure to wear.
scene: Run for thirty minutes and what you put on your forehead rides the sweat into your eyes.
So you rub them, and run the rest of the way like that.
Or you skip it altogether, worried about the white cast.
problem.close: We are trying to make neither.

steps.body: A finish that does not get in the way

This is where most of them fail.

steps.body: Staying put after contact with water

If it pills on the second coat, nobody applies a second coat.

company.lead: We create brands for people in motion.
company.body: PAROS is the first brand from AVORA LABS. It takes its name from an island in the Aegean, and it is made for anyone who moves — not only athletes.
company.etymology: AVORA joins the A of Athlete and Active — the one who moves — with the VORA of Vitality and Aura, the skin’s own liveliness.
company.awaiting: Waiting on copy from the team.

items.q: If you do not make it yourselves, how are you different?
items.a:
Most cosmetics brands use a manufacturer’s formula. Few of them publish that fact together with the standard they judge by.

We publish the six criteria, the points and the cutoffs first, and we follow the tally as it comes. That includes the scores of the formulas that failed.

items.q: Does an existing formula mean lower quality?
items.a:
The candidates are formulas that have already passed testing and review.

What we add is not an ingredient but a selection. We compare several candidates under the same conditions and filter them.

items.q: How do you pick the test panel?
items.a:
We recruit from running crews, climbing gyms and surfing communities. You keep doing the exercise you already do, and compare against a fixed set of criteria.

It starts in October 2026.

choice.lead: We publish the standard before the product.
choice.body:
Most brands show you a finished product and explain why it is good. We reversed the order.
Nothing is decided yet, and this is exactly when we publish what passes and what gets cut.
choice.body2:
Six criteria, 100 points in total. Eye sting is 30, white cast is 25.
Miss the cutoff on either one and we will not use it, however high the total.
choice.body3:
We set the standard. The people who actually run give the scores.
The candidates are existing formulas — not something we developed, and we say so here.

panel.lead: The people choosing are the people running.
panel.body: We are inviting a test panel from running crews, climbing gyms and surf communities. They receive two or three samples with the manufacturer's name hidden, and compare them against the same criteria during real activity.

criteria.body: After 30+ minutes of exercise, while sweat is running

After contact with water and a light towel dry
Until it has fully sunk in

meta.title: Brand — PAROS | AVORA LABS
meta.description: Where the name PAROS comes from and what the brand is for. An active lifestyle sun care brand named after the Aegean island.

origin.lead: PAROS stays with you through the beauty of every moment in motion, and through the moments after, when the skin needs care.

question.quote: When our bodies come most alive, why should the skincare our skin feels stay ordinary?
question.body: The beauty market sat at two extremes. Conventional cosmetics chased polish but felt heavy through a day of movement, while sports formulas shouted function and gave up the comfort and refinement skin deserves.
question.belief: We believe that walking, running, sweating, meeting water and moving again — every one of those moments is time spent looking after yourself.
question.close:
The more you move, the more careful the care your skin needs; the more comfortably you are cared for, the more freely you can move again.
Movement and care, living together naturally — that is why PAROS began.

island.lead: We did not simply borrow a name from a Greek island.
island.body: The hard Aegean sun, the wind across the skin, water you can see through, and white marble that has held the light for a very long time.
island.attitude: Paros is a place where the strength of nature and its beauty do not stand against each other. The sea stays clear under a hard sun, people move freely through rough wind, and stone worn by time only grows more beautiful.
island.stance: Strong but not coarse. Active but not heavy. Natural but not crude. That is the beauty PAROS has in mind.
island.note: So we do not copy the scenery over. What we keep is only the feeling of being there.

body:
The brand is PAROS, 파로스 in Korean.
The operating company is AVORA LABS (아보라랩스).

The name comes from the Greek island of Paros, but we are not
a travel brand for that island — we are a sun care brand made in Seoul.

items.body: Hard sun and natural light. The energy that starts a life in motion.
Wind passing across the skin. Movement, and freedom.
Sweat and sea, and the refresh after. The moment you gather yourself again.
What endures time and keeps only the essential. The depth of PAROS.

elements.note: These four run through the product, the design, the campaigns and the content.

body:
We do not develop a formula of our own.
We choose among formulas a manufacturer already holds — already tested, already reviewed.

Most Korean cosmetics brands are made the same way.
What is rare is saying so, and publishing the criteria used to choose.

What we add is not an ingredient but a selection.
Six criteria, their weights and their cut-offs are set and published first,
and we follow the scores given by people who actually move.

We publish the scores of the formulas that did not make it.
Saying only what was chosen, and not what was rejected,
is not choosing — it is looking like choosing.

audience.lead: This is not a brand for athletes.
audience.body: People who walk, run, travel, sweat and try new things. Anyone who lives actively has a place in PAROS.
audience.note: Not a product for the hours you train, but a brand that sits naturally in the whole of a moving day.

philosophy.quote: Movement is the purest, most powerful expression of being alive. From an easy walk at dawn to the moment you take hold of the day, PAROS stays out of the way and lets skin find its own texture.
philosophy.body: Right after you have moved hard, PAROS meets your skin with a precise, unhurried softness. That reversal is what makes it ours.
philosophy.beauty: White architecture, blue sea, hard sun, stone worn by wind. The beauty natural things already have. PAROS looks the same way — not adding more, but keeping only what a life in motion needs.

company.lead: It started with one very simple question.
company.origin: We thought strong movement and gentle care could go together, and that function and beauty need not stand against each other. Not a product for training hours, but beauty for a whole life in motion. AVORA LABS began from that thought.
company.name: AVORA joins the A of Athlete and Active — the one who moves — with the VORA of Vitality & Aura, the clear energy and poise that come from skin in good health.
company.toParos: AVORA LABS did not stop at making one product. What we found was not a category but a possibility — beauty for a life in motion. PAROS is the first brand built to carry that idea as a world of its own.

message.close: The beauty PAROS speaks of is not what is left after the movement stops. The movement, the sweat, the sunlight — all of it is part of the beauty.

items.q: What kind of brand is PAROS?
items.a: PAROS is an active lifestyle beauty brand for people in their twenties and thirties who move. The name comes from Paros, an island in the Aegean. It is the first brand created by AVORA LABS, and it is not made for athletes only but for anyone in motion.

items.q: Did you develop the formula yourselves?
items.a: No. The candidates are formulas the manufacturer already holds, ones that have passed testing and review. Instead of developing a new one, we publish the standard first and hand the scoring to people who actually train. The panel compares samples with the manufacturer's name hidden, against the same criteria, and we publish the tally as it comes.

items.q: What is the SPF rating of Daily Sunscreen?
items.a: SPF50+ / PA++++, the highest grade under Korean standards. We set that bar against long stretches of outdoor activity.

items.q: Can I wear it while working out?
items.a: Yes. Water resistance that holds through sweat is a condition we check when choosing the formula, along with a light finish that does not interfere with movement. If you have been sweating heavily, reapply before the two-hour mark.

items.q: Does it leave a white cast?
items.a: Leaving no white cast is a condition we do not trade away when choosing the formula. The panel checks it right after application and 30 seconds later under the same light, and a formula that misses the mark here is not used even if its total score is higher.
Fragrance free, with artificial scent and colour kept to a minimum, is one of the conditions we set. It is intended to work for anyone regardless of gender.

standards.lead: There are two things we won't give up.
standards.body: It must not sting when sweat runs into the eyes, and it must not leave a white cast on any skin tone. A formula that fails either one is dropped from the shortlist however good the rest of it looks. The judgement is not ours — it comes from the panel's tally.

analytics.heading: Traffic measurement
analytics.body: We count how often each page is opened using Cloudflare Web Analytics. What it records is the page address, where you came from, your browser and operating system, device type, country, and how long the page took to render. It sets no cookies, stores nothing in your browser, and does not use your IP address or browser details to single you out or follow you across other sites. So we cannot tell who visited, and we do not ask for consent.

cookies.heading: Cookies
cookies.body:
We use Google Analytics to count which screens are opened, how visitors arrived, and whether they went on to sign up. It sets cookies in your browser (values beginning with _ga) so that one visitor’s movements are counted together. What it keeps is the referring path, the screens viewed, the device and browser type, and an approximate region. We do not send names, email addresses or postal addresses to this tool.

You can turn it off at any time. Block cookies in your browser settings, or install the Google Analytics opt-out add-on that Google publishes. Blocking it does not affect your use of the site in any way.

rights.heading: Your rights and how to exercise them
rights.body:
You may ask us at any time to show, correct, delete, or stop processing your personal data. Tell us at the contact below and we will act without delay and let you know the result.

Every launch-notification and test-panel email carries an unsubscribe link that works immediately. We do not ask you to identify yourself for that.

If a legal representative or an authorised person asks on your behalf, we need a document showing that authority.

If you have an account, you can delete it yourself from My Page. Deleting it removes your email, name, and saved address. Order records stay for the five years Korean e-commerce law requires, and remain searchable by order number and phone number.

entrust.heading: Processing entrusted to others, and transfer abroad
entrust.body: We entrust processing to the companies below. Our contracts with them require that personal data be handled safely.

rows.work: Running the site and storing sign-up lists
rows.retention: Until you close your account or unsubscribe

entrust.note: These companies keep their servers outside Korea, so your data moves to those countries the moment you use the site. You may decline by not using the service, though that means you cannot sign up or send an enquiry. Blocking cookies in your browser stops the visit statistics.

destroy.heading: How we destroy personal data
destroy.body:
Once the retention period ends or the purpose is finished, we destroy the data without delay.

Electronic files are erased permanently by a method that cannot be reversed. Anything printed on paper is shredded or incinerated.

Where another law requires us to keep something, we store it separately for that period and destroy it afterwards.

safety.heading: How we keep it safe
safety.body:
As few people as possible handle personal data, and access is limited to what the work requires.

Everything sent between you and us is encrypted (HTTPS). The key used for unsubscribing is a random value that cannot be guessed.

This site neither receives nor stores payment details. They are handled only inside the payment provider’s own screens.

officer.heading: Data protection officer
officer.body: For questions, complaints, or help with harm relating to personal data, contact us below. We will answer without delay.

remedy.heading: Where to go if your rights are harmed
remedy.body: If you need help with a privacy matter — including when our answer did not satisfy you — these Korean bodies can advise you.

changes.heading: Changes to this policy
changes.body:
When this policy changes, we post what changes and when it takes effect on this page beforehand.

For an important change — such as collecting something new — we give notice 30 days before it takes effect, and ask for your consent again where that is needed.

Then we send the candidate formulas exactly as they are, with nothing settled.
Which one becomes the product is decided by your scores.

skin.alt: Sweat beading on a shoulder after exercising outdoors

notes.alt: An open blank notebook with a pen

what.heading: What you would be doing
what.body:
You receive two or three samples with the manufacturer’s name hidden.
You keep doing the activity you already do, and compare them against the six criteria below.
The evaluation runs from October to November 2026.

criteria.heading: The criteria

rows.how: Applied to the forehead and temples after 30+ minutes of activity, with sweat running
Photographed right after applying and 30 seconds later, under the same light
Pressing the back of the hand one minute after applying
Wet 20 minutes after applying, then wiped with a towel; residue checked
Layered again after 30 minutes; checked for pilling and patchiness
Timed until it sinks in completely

criteria.note: However high the total, a formula that fails the cut-off on stinging or white cast is not used.

rejected.heading: We publish the ones that did not make it
rejected.body:
When the tally is done we publish not only the chosen formula but the scores of the rejected ones.

Saying what you chose without saying what you turned down
is not choosing. It is looking like you chose.

form.heading: Apply

name.label: Name or nickname
name.hint: It does not have to be your legal name. Use what your crew calls you.

options.label: Two or three times a week
Four times a week or more

region.label: Where you live
region.hint: Used only to gauge shipping regions. We ask for a full address after selection.

consent.label: I agree to the collection and use of my personal information. (required)
consent.body: To run the test panel we collect your name (or nickname), email address, activity details and region. We use them only to send samples and to guide the evaluation, and we destroy them three months after the evaluation ends. You do not have to agree, but we cannot accept an application without it.

marketing.label: I agree to receive marketing messages. (optional)
marketing.body: You can unsubscribe at any time using the link in the emails we send.

night.label: I also agree to receive messages at night, 21:00–08:00. (optional)
night.body: So we can tell you at the moment something opens — a funding launch at midnight, for instance.

form.done: Your application has been received. We will let you know the outcome at this address during October.
form.error: It did not go through just now. Please try again in a moment.
form.invalid: Some fields are empty or in the wrong format.

pending.heading: What we have not decided yet
pending.body:
We have not yet decided what to give those who take part.
As soon as we do, the people who applied will hear first.
